title: Self-Custody & Lightning UX
description: The two hardest UX domains in Bitcoin — keys and payments — taught through the Design Guide's patterns and applied live to your Flow Redesign wireframes.

objectives: Design backup prompts, write-down ceremonies, and verification flows that carry life-savings stakes without paralyzing users
Compare recovery schemes — manual phrase vs cloud vs multi-key — and match them honestly to your user's reality
Explain channels and liquidity through their three user-visible surfaces: first-receive fees, receive limits, on-chain vs Lightning legibility
Apply honest/blameless/recoverable failure patterns to payment states in your own flow

resources.title: Bitcoin Design Guide — "Private key management" (introduction + scheme overview)
resources.desc: CORE. The reference for custody schemes: single key, cloud backup, external signers, multi-key, with the use-case flowchart for choosing among them. The chapter behind this week's tradeoff conversation.

resources.title: Bitcoin Design Guide — "Backup & recovery" (Daily Spending Wallet reference design)
resources.desc: CORE. The full worked reference: backup prompts during first use, the skip path, cloud vs manual, and the recovery flow itself. Follow the chapter's sub-pages (landing → cloud backup → manual backup → recovery).

resources.title: Bitcoin Design Guide — "Daily spending wallet" (sending & requesting sections)
resources.desc: CORE. The Guide's lightning-first reference wallet: payment requests, sending flows, human-readable status messaging, and the failure states worth copying. Navigate to the Sending and Requesting sub-chapters from this hub.

resources.title: Wallet teardowns: record your own
resources.desc: ACTIVITY. Screen-record the send flow and the backup flow in two different wallets on your own phone (your Lesson 2 wallets qualify). Watch your recordings back at half attention, as a tired user would. Note every moment of hesitation — yours, not hypothetical. This is your material, not someone else's video, and it feeds directly into wireframe v1. Drop your sharpest single observation in #week-4.

resources.title: Bitcoin Design Community — wallet recovery / backup UX call recording
resources.desc: OPTIONAL VIDEO. One recorded community call where backup or recovery design is discussed by working designers. Facilitator posts the current cohort's pick in #week-4.
